{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate by segment
conversion_by_segment = df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_by_segment.idxmax()

# Print the result
highest_segment"}
